stem.text: When 2-bromo-2-methylpropane reacts with aqueous sodium hydroxide, an alcohol is formed.
Which diagram describes the first step in the reaction mechanism?

A.alt: Mechanism diagram of (CH3)3CBr with delta+ on C and delta- on Br; one curly arrow beneath the C-Br bond, head at the bond. No hydroxide ion drawn.

B.alt: Mechanism diagram of (CH3)3CBr with delta+ on C and delta- on Br; one curly arrow from the C-Br bond with its head at Br. No hydroxide ion drawn.

C.alt: Mechanism diagram of (CH3)3CBr with delta+ on C and delta- on Br; HO- (lone pair shown) with a curly arrow to C, and a second curly arrow beneath the C-Br bond.

D.alt: Mechanism diagram of (CH3)3CBr with delta+ on C and delta- on Br; HO- (lone pair shown) with a curly arrow to C, and a curly arrow from the C-Br bond with its head at Br.
